notes: Mid-market SaaS - multi-tenant conversational agent platform. Evaluation started hosted_api then looking at Dedicated to hit stricter SLOs. Primary ask: streaming stability and deterministic latency under multi-tenant load + per-tenant rate limits/quotas. Wants tool calling (webhook callbacks) with ordered events and strong delivery guarantees. POC on hosted API shows good baseline but periodic spikes cause UI timeouts. Quote: 'We need first-token consistently <300ms and per-token streaming smoothness, otherwise user UX breaks.' Interested in reserved capacity pricing if Dedicated guarantees latency and predictable costs. Security: SOC2, SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for keying. Important: ability to enforce dynamic per-tenant quotas (qps, tokens/day, burst windows) and telemetry per-tenant for billing. Primary decision drivers: latency SLO, streaming stability, clear per-tenant rate limiting primitives, predictable pricing for committed consumption.
requirements_summary: Latency targets: first-token <= 250-300ms typical; tail latency P95 < 500ms; per-token steady stream with <=100ms inter-token preferred
Throughput: expected peak ~2000 concurrent chats across 300 tenants; typical 200-400 RPS bursty
Rate limits: per-tenant QPS + token/day caps + burst windows; want tenant-scoped throttling + soft/hard limits
Streaming: SSE/Websocket streaming with reconnection/resume + stable chunking; UI expects monotonic token stream
Tool calling: webhook callback reliability, idempotency keys, retry windows (30s), ordered tool events
Model pref: open/instruction-tuned Llama-like models, fallback to smaller model under load
Data & security: SOC2, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS, option for VPC/Dedicated for PII workloads
poc_notes: POC: 4 weeks on hosted_api; integration via streaming SSE + tool-calling webhooks
Observed median first-token ~180ms on hosted_api; occasional spikes to 700-900ms during peak bursts
Spike cause: observed at ~23:00 UTC correlating with high burst traffic - need isolation or dedicated pools
Tool-calls: callbacks delivered but 2% had duplicate deliveries when client retried; want idempotency guarantees
Caching: interested in prefix caching for common prompts to reduce cost and latency
Logging: requested tenant-tagged tracing for debugging, token-level cost breakdown per tenant
pricing_notes: Interested in committed reserved capacity for Dedicated if P99 latency SLA offered
ARR estimate 50k-150k depending on commit and overage rates
Wants clear per-tenant pricing guidance & metering (tokens/month) to pass to customers
Prefer consumption + reserved baseline with ability to burst; asked about volume discounts and overage caps
decision_criteria: Deterministic streaming latency under multi-tenant load
Native per-tenant quota/rate-limit primitives and flexible policies
Tool-calling reliability + ordered delivery with idempotency
Transparent pricing and predictable unit economics
